# Tomorrow Night Bright

Tomorrow Night Bright applies a high-contrast Tomorrow Night Bright color scheme on a black background to Obsidian. The recorded description presents the vivid palette as chosen for the legibility of code and notes in low-light workflows, and records nothing about supported modes, settings or plugins.

![Tomorrow Night Bright screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gbraad-obsidian/obsidian-tomorrow-night-bright-theme/HEAD/images/example.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Tomorrow Night Bright"
    author: "gbraad-obsidian"
    repo:   "gbraad-obsidian/obsidian-tomorrow-night-bright-theme"
    slug:   "tomorrow-night-bright"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/tomorrow-night-bright"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/gbraad-obsidian/obsidian-tomorrow-night-bright-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gbraad-obsidian/obsidian-tomorrow-night-bright-theme/HEAD/images/example.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a black-background, high-contrast Tomorrow Night Bright color scheme to Obsidian for clear, readable syntax highlighting. Use vivid, carefully chosen colors to boost code and note legibility in low-light workflows."
}
```
